subject: SOC2 evidence request: training logs + offboard retention details
messages:
From: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@kendallpartners.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security-ops@greenriverhealth.com
Date: 2028-04-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2 evidence request: training logs + offboard retention details

Hi Karthik,

Working through GreenRiver Health's SOC2 readiness review. A couple of quick asks on personnel controls that we need evidence for by EOD Thu: 

1) Training records: a roster showing mandatory security training completion for FY2028 (or Q1 snapshot) — we only need the first/last name and completion date for a sample of 25 employees (redacted PII is fine).
2) Background checks: an example of a redacted background-check attestation for a recent hire and your vendor name/process description.
3) Offboarding/credential revocation: confirmation of retention window for offboarding logs and a CSV export (headings OK) showing recent offboard events (date, role, deprovision steps completed).

If any of this is sensitive, a redacted sample or a link to a secured Drive share works. Please reply with what you can provide and an ETA.

Thanks,
Natalie Chen
Audit Manager, Kendall Partners
On behalf of GreenRiver Health Security Team

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@kendallpartners.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request: training logs + offboard retention details

Hi Natalie —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide redacted samples for each item and a short process note. High level: 

- Training records: attached is training_register_q1_2028.csv with a 25-person sample (names + completion dates). We redacted employee IDs and emails.
- Background checks: attached bgcheck-sample-redacted.pdf — we run vendor-based criminal & identity checks via VerityScreen; PDF includes our attestation and the vendor name.
- Offboarding logs: attached offboard_log_export_2027-2028.csv (heading-only export); retention policy is 7 years for audit artifacts; operational logs (e.g., deprovision runbooks) are retained for 2 years.

ETA: attachments below. If you need additional context (vendor invoices, SLAs), loop in procurement and I can pull those.

Action: Monica — can you confirm the exact column mapping for the offboard export and whether we should include manager name?

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-07T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request: training logs + offboard retention details

On Thu, Apr 7, 2028 at 11:03 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Action: Monica — can you confirm the exact column mapping for the offboard export and whether we should include manager name?

We exported the internal offboard audit report with these columns: employee_name (redacted to first + last), role, termination_date, deprov_account_disabled (Y/N), deprov_token_revoked (Y/N), sla_deprov_minutes, items_recovered (laptop/keys), notes. We normally exclude manager_name from shared audit samples to limit PII. If the auditor needs mapping to a manager for an investigation, we can provide a separate redacted mapping under NDA.

Lauren — FYI I also flagged the offboard CSV to exclude system IDs and add a note about evidence retention (7 years).

-Monica
Senior HR Operations Analyst
Redwood Inference

From: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@kendallpartners.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security-ops@greenriverhealth.com
Date: 2028-04-09T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request: training logs + offboard retention details

Karthik / team —

Received the files, thanks. Quick follow-ups after my review: 
- The training_register_q1_2028.csv looks good; could you confirm the course IDs for "Mandatory Security Awareness" and "Data Handling Basics"?
- Background-check vendor name (VerityScreen) is sufficient, please add the standard turnaround time you observe (avg days).
- Offboard export: your retention policy of 7 years is acceptable. For the CSV, please add an additional column showing "deprov_completed_timestamp" for the sample (we only need values for the 10 most recent events).

If you can send a tiny CSV with the 10 most recent offboards (deprov_completed_timestamp included) and the course IDs/turnaround time today, we should be able to close this item. Otherwise, list an ETA.

-Natalie
Kendall Partners
